skill.description: Use OpenAI GPT Image 2 edit through RunComfy for targeted image edits, multilingual text replacement, and multi-reference compositions.

security_audit.summary: Most static command and path findings are Markdown examples or inline code, not executable Ruby backticks or arbitrary filesystem access. The skill still depends on the RunComfy CLI and sends prompts plus image URLs to RunComfy remote services for processing.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is central to the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to get user confirmation before running RunComfy commands and to show the output directory first.

remediation.issue: Prompts and image URLs are processed by a third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy warning advising users not to submit sensitive images or private URLs.

remediation.issue: Placeholder URLs with ellipses trigger noisy static path findings.
remediation.suggestion: Replace placeholder URL paths with neutral examples that do not contain dot-dot-like sequences.

remediation.issue: RunComfy credentials are stored by the CLI in the user configuration directory.
remediation.suggestion: Document token revocation and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for isolated CI environments.

content.user_title: Edit Images with GPT Image Edit
content.value_statement: Precise image edits often drift from the original layout, identity, or text. This skill guides GPT Image 2 edits through RunComfy with preservation-focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Invokes the RunComfy GPT Image 2 edit endpoint through the local CLI.
Accepts up to 10 publicly reachable HTTPS image references.
Supports preservation-focused prompts for identity, layout, brand, and framing.
Provides guidance for multilingual in-image text replacement.
Documents size options, exit codes, and troubleshooting behavior.
Explains when to choose related image-editing models instead.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, account authentication, and network access.
Input images must be publicly fetchable HTTPS URLs.
Long compound edits can drift and may need multiple passes.
It is not optimized for large batch SKU galleries or portrait photorealism.

use_cases.title: Localize Ad Creative
use_cases.description: Replace embedded headlines with quoted multilingual text while preserving layout and brand marks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Scene Variants
use_cases.description: Combine a subject image with a reference room while keeping product identity stable.

use_cases.title: Revise Brand Assets
use_cases.description: Swap copy, background, or CTA placement in existing visuals without rebuilding the asset.

prompt_templates.title: Change a Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Use GPT Image Edit on this image URL: [URL]. Keep the subject unchanged. Replace the background with [new background]. Use size auto.

prompt_templates.title: Replace Image Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use GPT Image Edit to replace only the in-image headline with "[exact text]" in [language or script]. Keep layout and brand marks unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Compose Two References
prompt_templates.prompt: Use GPT Image Edit with image 1 as the subject and image 2 as the environment. Match lighting from image 2 and preserve subject identity.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Stable Multi-Step Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this requested edit: [edit request]. Split it into stable passes if needed, then run GPT Image Edit for the first pass only.

output_examples.input: Replace a poster headline with Japanese text and preserve the product photo.
output_examples.output: The skill keeps the original layout and brand mark, quotes the Japanese headline exactly, and returns an edited poster image.

output_examples.input: Place a photographed chair into a warm kitchen reference scene.
output_examples.output: The skill uses the chair as the subject and the kitchen as the scene, then matches lighting and color.

output_examples.input: Move a call-to-action from the top-right corner to the bottom-center.
output_examples.output: The skill scopes the spatial change clearly and preserves the rest of the design.

best_practices: Lead each edit with what must remain unchanged.
Quote any in-image text exactly and name the language or script.
Use size auto unless the requested edit changes framing.
anti_patterns: Combining many unrelated edits in one prompt.
Using private image URLs that the model server cannot fetch.
Asking for unsupported sizes or batch workflows this endpoint does not cover.

faq.question: What does this skill edit?
faq.answer: It edits existing images with GPT Image 2 through RunComfy.

faq.question: Do I need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects the RunComfy CLI and either login credentials or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN value.

faq.question: Can it use several reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented endpoint accepts up to 10 HTTPS image URLs.

faq.question: Can it replace text inside images?
faq.answer: Yes. Quote the exact replacement text and name the language or script.

faq.question: Where are outputs saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads generated files to the output directory selected by the user or agent.

faq.question: Is my content sent to a third party?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts and image URLs are sent to RunComfy for remote processing.
